投票切歌后，播放查询返回下一首歌曲、点歌用户与响度系数。

-- setup --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "request",
  "type": "user.update",
  "requestId": "user",
  "data": {
    "name": "alice",
    "email": " A@B.C ",
    "clientTimeMs": 100
  }
}

-- setup --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "request",
  "type": "music.pick",
  "requestId": "pick-current",
  "data": {
    "source": "qq",
    "id": "current"
  }
}

-- setup --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "request",
  "type": "music.pick",
  "requestId": "pick-netease",
  "data": {
    "source": "netease",
    "id": "shared"
  }
}

-- request --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "request",
  "type": "playback.skipVote",
  "requestId": "skip",
  "data": {}
}

-- response --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "response",
  "type": "playback.skipVote",
  "requestId": "skip",
  "data": {
    "currentVotes": 1,
    "requiredVotes": 1,
    "skipped": true
  }
}

-- request --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "request",
  "type": "playback.get",
  "requestId": "playback",
  "data": {}
}

-- response --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "response",
  "type": "playback.get",
  "requestId": "playback",
  "data": {
    "song": {
      "album": "",
      "artist": "artist",
      "durationMs": 3600000,
      "id": "shared",
      "name": "同名歌曲",
      "pictureUrl": "",
      "source": "netease",
      "webUrl": "",
      "lyric": "[00:00]lyric",
      "url": "https://example.invalid/shared"
    },
    "startedAtMs": 1,
    "user": {
      "name": "alice",
      "emailHash": "5d60d4e28066df254d5452f92c910092"
    },
    "volumeCoefficient": 0.75
  }
}
